Remark 4.2 ([?, Remark 4.2, p. 2]). For an infinite quiver of finite valence the divergence map is still defined on finitely supported weightings and its kernel is still saturated, but the rank formula of Theorem  ?? has no meaning, since all three of its terms are infinite. The correct statement in that setting is a description of the cycle space as a direct limit, which we do not pursue.
